items.author: BitcoinArchive
items.context: Bitcoin Archive: BTC tocó por última vez su precio realizado (precio promedio al que los holders movieron sus monedas por última vez) en 2022; hoy está en US$53.400 (con gráfico). Publicado con BTC cerca de US$59.000 tras la caída del día.
items.suggested_text:
Realized price is the denominator of MVRV, which is why this level matters more than any round number. With BTC near $59K and realized price at $53.4K, the ratio sits around 1.1: the average coin is still in profit, but only by roughly 10%.

Past bear markets have tended to bottom with price trading below that line, with the average holder underwater, and 2022 was the last time it happened. That's also why I read market temperature with MVRV as just one of four inputs, next to the 200-week average, the drawdown from the high and momentum, which don't always agree. Whether that 10% gap closes through price or through time is a different question entirely.
